answer: A whisper trellis: each identity's work is whispered through a trellis of independent peers, split by a prism into fragments so no single peer ever sees the whole proof, and only a quorum of different peers holding different fragments can vouch for it together. A fake can whisper to one peer, but it cannot collect a quorum of fragments from peers who never saw the same work, and a farm cannot share one trellis across a thousand fakes because each trellis is bound to one identity and each fragment needs its own real witness; a thousand fakes need a thousand separately whispered trellises.
